descriptionHtml:
100 × 70cm. Low profile. The bed for the second room.

Grizedale is a low-profile flat dog mattress in one size, 100 × 70cm, with a geometric grey cover that unzips and machine washes at 30°C.

Dogs do not stay in one room. They follow you to the kitchen, then to the desk, then back to the television, lying down in each spot for twenty minutes. One bed in the lounge means most of that day is spent on laminate.

This is the one you put in the second place. Low rather than walled, 100 × 70cm rather than enormous, so it slides under a desk, into a crate or along a skirting board.

What they get

  • One listed size, 100 × 70cm: A single footprint and a single price to weigh up.
  • A low mattress profile: Flat foam rather than high surrounding walls, so nothing is stepped over.
  • A geometric grey cover: Patterned fabric that adds interest without a loud colour.
  • A zipped cover at 30°C: It unzips for the machine. The foam is never washed or soaked.

Best for: Dogs who prefer a low, open shape, second rooms, crates and the spot beside a desk.

Why it is worth the money

£59 buys a mattress and not much else, which is deliberate. No bolsters, no second foam layer, no depth you are charged for twice. Most owners end up with more than one bed anyway, and this is the one that makes that affordable. And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

One size is the catch. There is no depth figure quoted and no no-flatten guarantee attached. It is the simple one, priced as the simple one. If your dog needs deep foam under them, say so and we will point you elsewhere.

Size and fit

SizeListed dimensions (cm)
One size100 × 70

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. If a measurement is unclear, ask before ordering. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Everyday care

Wash the removable cover at 30°C, following the sewn-in label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Do not wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most.

How do I know which size to get?

One size is listed, 100 × 70cm. Measure them and hold the number against that.

Will it fit inside a crate?

Measure your crate floor and compare it against 100 × 70cm. The profile is low.

Will it suit an older dog who finds it hard to get up?

All we can say is what it is: a low mattress shape with no surrounding walls. Talk to your vet before settling on a surface.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes. The cover unzips and takes a 30°C machine wash. Air-dry it fully before refitting.

What if my dog just won't use it?

Then send it back. That is what the 100 nights are for. We collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Put a low 100 × 70cm mattress where they already lie down.
